about_the_game:
🃏 Brisca Like Never Before!

Celebrate the 10th anniversary of the most popular card game by Quarzo Apps with this fully revamped version of Brisca. Enjoy fast-paced, strategic matches in online multiplayer, offline vs AI, or practice mode.

A complete and customizable experience faithful to the traditional Spanish card game, now with improved graphics, powerful new features, and smooth gameplay.

✨ Key Features

  • 🃏 High-definition cards, customizable backs, and smooth animations.

  • 📱 Play in portrait or landscape mode.

  • 🎴 Use the Spanish, French, or Italian (Napoletane) deck.

  • 🧠 Smart AI with 4 difficulty levels and configurable rules.

  • 🌐 Online multiplayer with friends or single-player games.

  • 🔈 Realistic sounds with adjustable volume.

  • 🎓 Full tutorial and in-game help.

  • 🔧 Advanced settings: card size, rules, effects, and more.

  • 🔋 Graphics optimized for low battery consumption.

🕹️ Game Modes

  • Interactive tutorial

  • Practice mode (with undo option)

  • Single-player vs AI

  • Local multiplayer (coming soon)

  • Online multiplayer

Brisca (also known as Briscola or Briscas) is a traditional card game played in Spain, Italy, Puerto Rico, Cuba, and many other countries. The goal is to win tricks and collect the highest-scoring cards. Easy to learn, hard to master.
